tagline: A three-ton brawler that pays in blood to stay nose-to-nose — and pins you there

featuredCards.title: STAMPEDE
featuredCards.caption: Ploughs through the board, shoving and hurting everything she runs over. Distance is not a defence against her.

featuredCards.title: UNSTOPPABLE CHARGE
featuredCards.caption: Every space she covered adds to the hit and it cannot be cancelled — but the recoil comes off her own bar.

featuredCards.title: IMPALED BY THE HORNS
featuredCards.caption: Nose-to-nose, you do not get to leave for the rest of the turn. That is where her +1 lives.

featuredCards.title: 15,000 POUNDS OF MUSCLE
featuredCards.caption: Your card's value stops mattering. She takes two damage and simply walks through the block.
